VBO:0200725.summary: Busy days suited Ralph, a six-year-old Jackapoo whom Almost Home Dog Rescue described as clever and eager to explore. He liked to snooze beside people after his adventures. Initially a little shy in foster care, he soon settled in; the rescue also reported that he visited the groomer a couple of times a year.
VBO:0200725.shortDescription: Almost Home described Ralph as an active Jackapoo who loved exploring, settled after initial shyness and enjoyed an evening snooze.
